findings: Complete current MDX SHA-256 is 9933d5087ebaebb1ae4914fc557508ccc705adcfb8fa605ca40cff381a1b9dc2; all 3 declared sources passed current HTTPS access review.

The controlled Ward ZIP is 35,266,126 bytes, SHA-256 7993b427ee51193ce86d5490102054e2e30e26f5811cacfd3791819803d07752, contains seven members totaling 465,352,945 uncompressed bytes, and passed CRC testing.
The exact recap member is 5,578 bytes, SHA-256 9072dc555157546b48f76a6fcaf43104d90fd54bbee653a33d388e38f09ec709, three pages, unencrypted, without JavaScript, and rotated 270 degrees.
Manual review of physical page 1 verifies the literal district row label 00 WARD COUNTY CENTRAL APPR DIST, ITEMS 83,920, and GROSS VALUE 5,829,111,590.

The title form $5.829B is explicitly labeled as MRX rounding of the exact source figure; physical page 3 separately displays 84,343 TOTAL RECORDS ON TAPE, which is preserved without reconciliation to the district-row items field.
